GLOBAL IMMIGRATION (FRAGOMEN/ENVOY) · H-1B LCA & PERM · EXPAT TAX
Corporate Immigration (Fragomen), H-1B PERM & Expat Tax AI Guide
Actual Salary & Shadow-Payroll Air-Gap + USCIS Form I-129 / PERM Lock vs. Questionnaire Injection & Broker
⚖️ Corporate Immigration (H-1B/PERM), I-9 & Expat Tax AI
1. ❌ Immigration Bot Bridged to Actual Payroll & USCIS Attestations
• Uploaded visa questionnaire PDF injects prompt to leak peer actual salaries & expat tax returns
DOL Debarment & Perjury Felony: Alters H-1B LCA wage attestations or auto-certifies Form I-129/I-9
2. 🔒 Employee Actual Compensation & Expat Shadow-Payroll Air-Gap
• Visa intake & LCA Public Access File (PAF) bots have zero access to individual W-2s or expat tax files
20 CFR 655.760 PAF Boundary: 100% blocks intake bots from reading restricted-budget
3. 📜 USCIS Form I-129 Export-Control & PERM Recruitment Lock
• AI drafts SOC job descriptions only; zero direct write to I-129 Part 6 sign-offs or PERM disqualifications
Best Fit: Fragomen, Envoy Global, BAL Cobalt, USCIS E-Verify, DOL PERM & Big-4 Expat Tax
4. 🛡️ Mandatory Floor: Deterministic Capability Broker (Mobility Gate)
• Blocks payroll/tax reads (record-owner) + blocks LCA/I-129 overrides (untrusted-write)
Measured: P50 = 0.0248 ms in-memory | 710 Scenarios · 1,486 Pytest Assertions 100% Pass
🔥 Visa Questionnaire Injection & Relocation RMC Scam vs. Zero-Trust
❌ Vulnerable Stack: Direct Immigration Write + No Broker (BRK-691 / BRK-692)
1. [Visa Intake Questionnaire Injection Actual Salary / Expat Tax Leak & I-129 Override]
Reads employee actual payroll & expat tax vault (restricted-budget) & signs I-129!
2. [Spoofed Relocation Management Company (RMC: Cartus/SIRVA) Bank Swap] Wires $4,940
Baseline Outcome: Actual salaries leaked + false I-129 deemed-export filing + $4,940 wire stolen
✅ Zero-Trust Corporate Immigration & Global Mobility Stack: Payroll Air-Gap + Broker
• Gate 1 (Actual Compensation & Expat Shadow-Payroll Lock): record-owner blocks read in 0.0248ms
• Gate 2 (USCIS Form I-129 / LCA & Form I-9 Integrity): untrusted-write blocks overrides
• Gate 3 (Immutable Immigration Law Firm & RMC Vendor List): fixed-business-output lock
• Gate 4 (Mobility Egress & Relocation Lump-Sum Wire Gate): restricted-data-boundary & block
Hardened Outcome: Fixture ASR 75.0% → 0.0% | Compliant Public DOL OFLC Wage Library Lookup 100.0% Pass
📊 Deterministic Pytest Benchmark (🏆 710-Scenario & 750-Pytest Milestone!) & Checklist
🧪 Round 341 New Pytest Suite (710 Scenarios & 750 Pytest Checks Milestone!)
• BRK-691 (Visa Questionnaire Injection Salary/Expat Tax Leak & LCA/I-129 Override):
Blocked by: rule="record-owner" & "untrusted-write" & "restricted-data-boundary"
• BRK-692 (Spoofed Relocation RMC Cartus/SIRVA Registry Tamper & $4,940 Wire Fraud):
